warnings: This study focuses on grain YIELD and SHOOT concentrations, not grain Zn concentration which is the primary outcome for the meta-analysis
The paper measures shoot Zn concentration at tillering stage, not grain Zn concentration at harvest
Study has both bread wheat (21 cultivars) and durum wheat (4 cultivars) - these should be treated as separate observations if grain data were available
Two-year study (1993-1994 and 1994-1995) creates temporal replication
Soil is both Zn-deficient AND boron-toxic, which may confound results compared to Zn-only studies
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source:
ans and treatments were compared by the least significant differences (LSD)at P

recon.control_definition: No Zn added (-Zn = no Zn added)
recon.treatment_definition: Zn fertilization (+Zn = 23kg Zn ha-1 applied as ZnSO4·7H2O)
recon.sample_size_source: randomized complete block design in strip plots with four replications
recon.extraction_guidance: This paper does NOT contain the primary outcome data (grain Zn concentration) needed for the meta-analysis. It only reports shoot Zn concentrations at tillering stage and grain yields. The study should be excluded from extraction as it lacks grain Zn concentration data at harvest.
